scope: Pure Lattice-side profile validation and wrapping-i64 reference evaluation; no producer process, operation-pack dispatch, or consumer publication.
covered: exact i64 minimum, maximum, zero, and values beyond binary64 exact range
rejection of leading plus, negative zero, leading zeroes, whitespace, fractions, hex, and out-of-range decimals
rejection of JSON numbers as integer transport
rejection of empty, underflowing, oversized-arity, and invalid-input-index programs
non_claims: This does not execute or qualify a producer worker.
This does not define the Noble producer wire format or CLI.
This does not add an operation-pack runtime, workflow node, scheduler, or effect route.
Passing pure tests does not establish OS sandboxing, publication, or consumer acceptance.
